note: Both sets contain identical misbinding errors where Keynote labels (A1/A4 and B1/B4) are swapped with their corresponding grid locations, leading to incorrect label conditions and section properties for those beams. Set A is preferred because it extracts the full condition text for the beam opening radius ('around edges of openings in beams'), whereas Set B truncates it to 'around edges', making it vague.
remarks: Both sets fail to correctly map Keynotes A1/A4 and B1/B4 to their grid locations (swapping them). Both also omit the Keynote ID 'E6' in the conditions for the Roof Beam claim (Claim 8 in A, Claim 7 in B), unlike other beam claims which include the Keynote ID.
